en.headline: Police arrest driver after finding suspected drugs in Wan Chai car
en.dek: Officers stopped a private car near 221 Gloucester Road early Monday and seized small amounts of suspected methamphetamine, cocaine and cannabis; a 34-year-old man was arrested for trafficking.
body: Police arrested a 34-year-old non-Chinese man early on Monday after finding suspected drugs in a private car stopped on Gloucester Road in Wan Chai.

Officers on patrol near 221 Gloucester Road noticed the parked vehicle and stopped it for checks around 1am to 2am. Inside the car they found about 3 grams of suspected methamphetamine, 1.6 grams of suspected cocaine and 1.6 grams of suspected cannabis flowers, with a total estimated street value of about HK$3,200.

The driver was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in a dangerous drug and is being detained for investigation. The case has been handed to the Wan Chai District Crime Investigation Team 7, police said.
Trafficking in a dangerous drug is a serious offence under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance. Police have not released further details of the man or the exact circumstances of the stop.

zh.headline: 警灣仔截查私家車檢懷疑毒品 拘34歲男司機
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨在告士打道221號對開截查一輛私家車，檢獲少量懷疑冰毒、可卡因及大麻花，34歲非華裔男司機涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。
body: 警方周一凌晨在灣仔告士打道截查一輛形跡可疑的私家車，檢獲少量懷疑毒品後，拘捕一名34歲非華裔男司機。
警方表示，港島總區衝鋒隊人員在告士打道221號對開巡邏時，發現該輛私家車形跡可疑，遂上前截查。車內檢獲約3克懷疑冰毒、1.6克懷疑可卡因及1.6克懷疑大麻花，估計市值約3200港元。
該名司機涉嫌「販運危險藥物」被捕，現正被扣留調查。案件交由灣仔警區刑事調查第七隊跟進。
根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行。警方暫未公布被捕人進一步背景或截查詳情。
